variants.headline: Still in view: strike collapses
variants.sub: The colony has seen a strike collapse.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. A strike has collapsed in {colony}.

We judge {target} critically. A failed labour action is a proper occasion to ask whether responsibility has been exercised adequately, rather than to excuse poor judgment through the convenience of the outcome.

variants.headline: Still in view: labour action loses its course
variants.sub: A strike in the colony has ended in collapse.
variants.body:
This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event. The colony has seen a strike collapse.

We judge {target} critically. A failed labour action is a proper occasion to ask whether responsibility has been exercised adequately, rather than to excuse poor judgment through the convenience of the outcome.

variants.headline: Still in view: a strike ends in collapse
variants.body:
Our attention to this story continues after {months_running} months, with the original report still the starting point. A strike in the colony has ended in collapse.

We judge {target} critically. A failed labour action is a proper occasion to ask whether responsibility has been exercised adequately, rather than to excuse poor judgment through the convenience of the outcome.
